message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films that should keep you on the edge of your seat:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological dread, with iconic imagery and Jack Nicholson’s unforgettable performance. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotional trauma. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A smart, socially conscious horror that mixes satire with genuine scares. |
| 4 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A well‑crafted haunted‑house story that revitalized the paranormal genre. |
| 5 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight horror that turns a pastoral festival into a nightmarish ritual. |
| 6 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Tension built around silence; a fresh take on the “survival horror” formula. |
| 7 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A modern folk‑tale of an unrelenting curse that’s both creepy and conceptually unique. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | A psychological horror that uses a monster as a metaphor for grief. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A remake of the Japanese classic that still feels fresh and unsettling. |
|10 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Robert Eggers | A slow‑burn, atmospheric horror set in 1630s New England. |
|11 | **Suspiria (2018)** | 2018 | Luca Guadagnino | A visually stunning reimagining of Dario Argento’s 1977 classic. |
|12 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Drew Goddard | A meta‑commentary on horror tropes that delivers both laughs and chills. |
|13 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Oren Peli | Low‑budget found‑footage that still manages to terrify with its realism. |
|14 | **The Others** | 2001 | Alejandro Amenábar | A gothic thriller with a twist that keeps you guessing until the end. |
|15 | **It (2017)** | 2017 | Andy Muschietti | A faithful adaptation of Stephen King’s novel that balances camp and genuine terror. |

Feel free to pick based on your mood—whether you want a psychological thriller, a supernatural haunt, or something that plays with genre conventions. Happy watching!
